title: Mateo Falcone
author: Prosper Mérimée
note: Corsica, the early eighteen-hundreds: a wild island of shepherds, bandits and family honour. A ten-year-old boy, alone at home, must decide whether to hide a wounded outlaw. The story uses the passé simple, a literary past tense: when you hear il fit, il dit, or elle obéit, just think: he did, he said, she obeyed.
